about: Numbers, never audio: what the desktop visualizer's feel (ui/src/lib/musicFeel.ts) reads from real music, through the page's own pipeline emulated offline - each track decoded at 48 kHz and down-mixed to mono as 0.5 (L + R), the analyser as player/vizAudio.ts sets it up (FFT 2048, Blackman window, no smoothing, -90..-22 dB to bytes, read 60 times a second), lib/visualizer.ts bandLayout and bandsFromBins, then musicFeel. readings: what musicFeel holds once a second of heard music - density (onsets a second x 100), high (the share above about 2 kHz x 1000), flat (noisiness x 1000). full: aggr's 5/50/95% and the share of time (%, after the first 10 s) in smooth / in between / aggressive, from the full 60-a-second run; before: the same shares under the tuning before 2.0.0-player.34 (null for a copy made since). kind: incompetech's own description of the track (calm "Calming, Relaxed"; between "Grooving", "Bright"; heavy "Aggressive, Driving"; builds - starts calm and builds). heldOut: kept out of the tuning. gainDb: the same track made louder or quieter, to hold the tuning to how loud a record is mastered. lufs: integrated loudness as decoded (+ gainDb).
